title: just-deliver environment definition
description: What `jd env up` provisions for an environment: the parts its offers reach in its type's layer (docs/architecture/components.md section 3); the descriptor's values are those parts' exports, keyed by part name. Checked against the catalog, not here: the type is declared, a type with `approval: true` carries the `approval` block, and the offers name declared components and at most one runtime.

name.description: Environment name; same pattern as the descriptor's.

region.description: Where the environment is deployed; the descriptor's region (env.region), the same on every machine.

type.description: An environment type the catalog declares.

offers.description: The components and the runtime (at most one) the environment offers, by name. `jd env up` deploys what they reach: the layer's shared resources reached through `uses` and, in an `environment` layer, the offered components' environment parts.
